neel: Quick headcount — LAN party saturday at my place if folks want a non-office option. Will have 6 seats and beer. No pressure. :beer:
anya: Saturday works for me! i'll bring a router in bridge mode and a bag of cables. :cable:
samir: i'm keen but can only make evenings. does the place have monitor space for a 144hz screen?
neel: yes 1x 144hz monitor and a spare 1080p. also a PS5 for couch co-op.
infra-bot: Reminder: bring ethernet where possible for best perf. Guest network limited to 100mbps.
tim: i'll bring mario party and a bag of pretzels. also can do split-screen rocket league for warmups.
zoe: tempted. anyone up for a retro cartridge swap table? i've got an extra SNES controller.
anya: vote: :one: if you want chill co-op, :two: for competitive tourney
neel: :one:
anya: :one:
samir: :two:
tim: :one:
zoe: :one:
neel: looks like chill co-op wins. we'll keep a casual playlist and breaks for snacks. i'll DM location to confirmed RSVPs.
